WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM per_telescope
), above_first AS (
  SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse_rate, b.baseline AS first_baseline
  FROM per_telescope p
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline b
  WHERE p.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
), second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM above_first
), final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.first_baseline, b.baseline AS second_baseline
  FROM above_first a
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline b
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline
FROM final_telescopes;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with no non-NULL pulsepersec values are excluded because their per-telescope average is NULL; AVG also ignores NULLs when calculating both baselines and final means.
